section_summary.extract_value: This section reports descriptive statistics for the total sample. Independent samples t-tests showed no significant ethnic differences in participants' age (t(589) = .21, p > .05) and BMI (t(589) = .90, p > .05), and no significant between-group differences in marital status, although religion differed (z = 22.45, p < .001). The mean of all 13 items of the BAS for the total sample was 3.63 (SD = .72).
section_summary.evidence_source: Independent samples t-tests showed no significant ethnic differences in participants' age, t(589) = .21, p > .05, and BMI, t(589) = .90, p > .05. There were no significant between-group differences in the distribution of marital status, z = .90, p > .05, although there were differences in religion, z = 22.45, p < .001. For the total sample, the mean of all 13 items of the BAS was 3.63 (SD = .72).
